Set.Author: Nikola Hristov
Set.Message:
build(deps): update dependencies and adjust homepage URL

This commit updates several key dependencies in the Cocoon project to their latest versions. These include:
- `@effect/platform` upgraded from `0.94.0` to `0.94.1`
- `@tauri-apps/plugin-fs` upgraded from `2.4.4` to `2.4.5`
- `effect` upgraded from `3.19.13` to `3.19.14`
- `@effect/language-service` upgraded from `0.62.5` to `0.69.1`
- OpenTelemetry packages updated to version `0.210.0` and `2.4.0`
- Dev dependencies such as `@playform/build` and `@types/node` also received minor bumps

In addition to dependency updates, the `homepage` field in `package.json` has been adjusted from ending in `#readme` to using `?tab=readme-ov-file`, which provides a more accurate link to the readme overview on GitHub.

Furthermore, the `--provenance` flag was removed from the `npm publish` command in the GitHub workflow due to compatibility issues or changed requirements in the publishing process.

These changes aim to keep the project up-to-date with the latest improvements and security patches while refining external references.
